text.en:
16th. SEPTEMBER, 2000 No. S 78 EMERGENCY (PUBLIC HEALTH) (FOOD) ORDER, 1998 (S 17/98} Notification under section 1 ( 1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1), the Minister of Health hereby appoints the 1st. January, 2001 as the date on which the Emergency (Public Health) (Food) Order, 1998 shall come into force. Dated this 28th. day of Jamadilawal, 1421 Hijriah corresponding to the 28th. day of August, 2000. PEHIN ORANG KAYA LAlLA WIJAYA DATO SERI SETIA

HAJI AWANG ABDUL AZIZ BIN BEGAWAN PEHIN UDANA KHATIB

DATO SERI PADUKA HAJI AWANG UMAR Acting Minister of Health, Brunei Darussalam.
